signal: IntelAgree shipped Saige Assist, its generative-AI contract assistant, and is pushing AI-led CLM growth

email.body1:
Brent, saw IntelAgree leaning hard into Saige Assist and AI-led contract management.

When the product story gets that sharp, the bottleneck usually moves to the SDR bench: more in-market accounts than the team can research, write, and follow up on. Our AI SDR handles the research, writing, and follow-up autonomously, so coverage scales 3-5x per rep without new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for IntelAgree off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brent, quick follow-up for IntelAgree.

Most SDR teams lose the day to manual research and rewriting the same opener, which caps how many target accounts ever get a real touch. The fix is letting the rep focus on conversations while the worker handles volume and personalization at once.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to three of IntelAgree's top accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them and the research behind each?
email.body3:
Brent, last bit of proof for IntelAgree.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IntelAgree's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brent, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SDR output without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ramp time and follow-up volume are their own grind, and timing has to be right.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team's motion? I'll tailor it to IntelAgree either way.
